```{r}
library(Matrix)
library(data.table)

source("./calc_spongEffects.R")
```

```{r}
# Read sparse matrix
X <- readMM("../datasets_prepro/GSM6592049_M2_prepro_X.mtx")
rownames(X) <- fread("../datasets_prepro/GSM6592049_M2_prepro_cells.txt", header = FALSE)$V1

# Read metadata
var <- fread("../datasets_prepro/GSM6592049_M2_prepro_var.csv")

ceRNA_interactions <- fread("../networks/SPONGE/breast_invasive_carcinoma/breast_invasive_carcinoma_interactionNetwork.csv")
ceRNA_centralities <- fread("../networks/SPONGE/breast_invasive_carcinoma/breast_invasive_carcinoma_networkAnalysis.csv")

ensembl <- 'ensemble_id'
feature <- 'feature_type'
```

```{r}
modules <- create_Sponge_modules(var, ceRNA_interactions, ceRNA_centralities, mscor=0.1, padj=0.05, feature_col=feature, RNAs=c("lncRNA","protein_coding"), ensembl_col=ensembl, n_modules=20, n_cores=1)

colnames(X) <- var[,get(ensembl)]

effects <- calc_spongeEffects(X, modules, oe=TRUE, gsva=TRUE, ssgsea=TRUE, n_cores=1)
```

```{r}
fwrite(as.data.table(effects$gsva.modules, keep.rownames = "rownames"), "../datasets_prepro/GSM6592049_M2_prepro_sponge_gsva.csv")
```

```{r}
filename <- "../datasets_prepro/GSM6592049_M2_prepro_X.mtx"

file_clean <- sub("_X$", "", tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(filename)))

lapply(names(effects), function(x) file.path("..", "datasets_output", paste0("spongeffects_", x, "_sponge_", file_clean, ".csv")))
```
